Order No. 02 / Dated : 05.06.2025.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with CID P.S. Case No. 09/2025 for the offences registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 470, 471, 506 and 34 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in this case and the entire matter is related to civil disputes which is going on since long.
He further submits that all the allegations made in the FIR against these petitioners are general and omnibus in nature, as such they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
5. Having regard to the facts of the case and looking to the allegations made against these petitioners, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from today and the Sumant Kumar @ Suman Kumar S/O Rajendra ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp. ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61525882/
